a.lede: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
a.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

b.lede: New York governor Kathy Hochul has signed into law a five-year ban on the sale of AI chatbot toys.
b.title: New York state bans AI chatbot toys for kids
